title: 第2章 莫欺少年穷，不如人情世故
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“还莫欺少年穷？这修仙可不止靠打打杀杀，人情世故有时可比这实力重要。”

    “不过一未曾崛起的少年，在那些大能面前，杀了也就杀了。”

    “在没有绝对的实力前，嚣张可能会死哦！”

    微生璃月一连串恍如蝼蚁的话语落下，直将叶不凡刚刚测出极品变异雷灵根的优越感砸个稀碎，脸上颜色白了又红，红了又青，好看得紧。

    这凤鸾宝架上的女人，他叶不凡记住了，总有一天他会将这人踩在脚底下，让她为今日的所作所为后悔。

    周围人看见凤鸾车架驶来，全场愕然。

    金丹期妖兽开路，车身四周萦绕七彩神光，零散的花瓣从车上落下，带着一股令人舒适的气息，无数由灵气幻化而成的蝴蝶在车身附近飞舞。

    凤鸾宝架四角，站着四位他们看不出修为的青衣仆人，越是看不穿，便越是觉得神秘。

    这是从哪里来的大小姐，排场如此豪横，说的话也这么嚣张。

    负责今日收徒事宜的金长老，在看见凤鸾车架驶来的瞬间，他就已经探出神识落到车架周围。

    很可惜，无论是车里的情况，还是守在周围的四人，他竟感受不到这几人的修为。

    要知道他现在已入元婴，连他都感应不到，那这几人的修为肯定在他之上，已经达到元婴中期或者后期。

    由四位元婴大佬护行，这凤鸾架上的女子身份必然不简单。

    刚刚抵达第一个任务地点，就听到男主叶不凡那番经典打脸发言，微生璃月忍不住笑出声：“统子，这场景在小说里看看还可以，现实中怎么感觉这么尴尬啊！”

    “哈哈哈，莫欺少年穷……”

    笑死她了，她记得网友们怎么说后面来着，莫欺中年穷，莫欺老年穷，死者为大。

    “呃……宿主，你先别笑了，记得完成任务。”

    “作为装逼系统的宿主，你怎么能允许主角比你还能装，我们得把场子找回来，成为全场最亮的崽。”装逼系统提醒道。

    还沉浸在主角打脸搞笑场景中的微生璃月经过系统提醒，立马止住笑意，开始进入人设：“统子，快把那些布灵布灵的特效全部拿出来，我们一起亮瞎他们的眼。”
content_en:
"Why don't you bully a young man into being poor? Cultivating an immortal requires more than just fighting and killing. Humanity and sophistication are sometimes more important than strength."

"But a young man who has never risen before those powerful men will kill him."

"Before you have absolute strength, arrogance may lead to death!"

Weisheng Liyue's series of ant-like words shattered Ye Bufan's sense of superiority, which he had just detected from the top-grade mutated thunder spirit root, to pieces. His face turned white and red, red and blue, and he looked very good-looking.

Ye Bufan remembered the woman on the Feng Luan treasure shelf. One day he would trample this person under his feet and make her regret what she did today.

When people around saw Fengluan's carriage approaching, they were all stunned.

The golden elixir stage monsters opened the way, and the car body was surrounded by colorful divine lights. Scattered petals fell from the car, bringing with it a comfortable atmosphere. Countless butterflies transformed from spiritual energy were flying near the car body.

At the four corners of the Feng Luan Treasure Stand, stood four servants in green clothes whose cultivation they could not discern. The harder they could see through them, the more mysterious they felt.

Where did this young lady come from? She looks so arrogant and speaks so arrogantly.

Elder Jin, who was in charge of recruiting disciples today, had already reached out his consciousness and landed around the frame the moment he saw Fengluan's carriage approaching.

It was a pity that whether it was the situation in the car or the four people standing around, he couldn't feel the cultivation of these people.

You must know that he has entered the Yuanying now, and even he can't sense it, so the cultivation level of these people must be above him, and they have reached the middle or late stage of the Yuanying.

Protected by four Nascent Soul bosses, the identity of the woman on Feng Luanjia must not be simple.

As soon as she arrived at the first mission location, she heard the classic slap-in-the-face speech of the male protagonist Ye Bufan. Weisheng Liyue couldn't help laughing: "Tongzi, this scene is okay in the novel, but why does it feel so embarrassing in reality!"

"Hahaha, don't bully young people into poverty..."

She laughed to death. She remembered what netizens said later, don't bully the middle-aged and poor, don't bully the old and poor, the dead will be the most important.

"Uh... Host, stop laughing now and remember to complete the mission."

"As the host of the pretense system, how can you allow the protagonist to be more pretentious than you? We have to get our place back and become the brightest kid in the room." the pretense system reminded.

Weisheng Liyue, who was still immersed in the funny scene of the protagonist slapping her face, was reminded by the system. She immediately stopped smiling and started to enter the character: "Tongzi, quickly bring out all the special effects of buling buling, and let's blind their eyes together."
title_en: Chapter 2 Don’t bully a young man into being poor, it’s better to be human and sophisticated
